scientific_integrity: The tree-edge mass-imbalance identity is established background; the asserted new ingredient is the exact radial realization of the center-localized nerve cost. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite ultrametrics of at least two points and radii between zero and the diameter; not arbitrary finite metrics.
Exact localized transport cost, not the support-dependent pointwise cost or nerve-map stability constants.
Numerical checks do not prove the unlimited theorem; the proof is the shell decomposition and tree flow formula.
Novelty relative to unindexed literature remains a residual priority risk.
title: Exact radial-tree transport formula for localized nerve metrics on finite ultrametrics
